resources.string: A couple of quick steps before RouteForge can simulate a location on this device.
Your device administrator has disabled Developer Options. RouteForge cannot enable mock locations on a managed device where this capability is restricted.
RouteForge needs Developer Options turned on before it can inject a mock location, since Android hides mock-location controls until Developer Options is enabled.
Open About Phone and tap the Build Number entry 7 times until you see "You are now a developer".
Android only allows one app at a time to simulate GPS locations. RouteForge must be chosen as that app before it can inject a route.
Open Developer Options, find "Select mock location app", and choose RouteForge.
